{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.16

|arg= local
|eff= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Sets the fuel consumption coefficient, which is a multiplier of the [[CfgVehicles_Config_Reference#fuelConsumptionRate|fuel consumption rate]] in config. It doesn't affect fuel leakage or refueling.

|s1= vehicle [[setFuelConsumptionCoef]] coef

|p1= vehicle : [[Object]]

|p2= coef: [[Number]] in range 0..1000 - Values larger than 1 increase fuel consumption, and values between 0 and 1 decrease fuel consumption. 0 disables fuel consumption

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>myTank setFuelConsumptionCoef 10; // consume 10x more fuel than default</sqf>

|seealso= [[getFuelConsumptionCoef]]
}}
